reviews: Simple, Sturdy, and Works Great This laptop stand is very solid and does exactly what I needed it to do. It raises the laptop to a much better viewing height, which helps with posture and makes the desk setup feel more organized and professional. The aluminum build feels sturdy, it doesn’t wobble, and it holds the laptop securely. It also helps with airflow so the laptop stays cooler. Overall, great quality for the price and a nice addition to any desk setup.

My laptop fits the stand perfectly, it’s light weight I can carry it with one hand. It’s stable, it’s tight and strong, so strong in fact I couldn’t get it to close all the way at the bottom. Easy to assemble but difficult to push all the way in. Its stability is great, doesn’t move or shake. Looks sleek. Very functionabke.
GREAT PRICE, STURDY, EASY TO PUT TOGETHER...
Easy to build and attach to your laptop.

This is a very sturdy stand. It does need to be assembled, and connecting the parts takes a bit of force, as they fit together tightly. However that likely contributes to the sturdiness of the assembled product. My desk is not very large, and having this to support my laptop, gives me room to have an external keyboard below the laptop, to maximize the space I have. (I need the external keyboard for specific functions that I use for work, that the laptop keyboard doesn't support.) The only thing that I can see that could be better, is the gripper pads that were already in place. They don't stick very tightly to the bars of the stand. They still work as expected, but the edges tend to lift away from the surface they should stick tightly to.
Works real good and easy to assemble. Being used on my work desk to assist with my overall view of my screens, and computers.

Really good product for the price point. The frame is really sturdy and the built is solid. I love how it was so easy to set it up from the package and I was able to use it off the package. The laptop grip is also really well, my laptop doesn't wobble while using it. I love how I can fold it up and take it with me to my classes, and it doesn't stand out cause it's black so it kinda blends in. I really loved this product. Would recommend.
